text:
sam-ae: Quick flag 18 Enterprise prospect SolaceMed wants a 12mo Dedicated commit but with non-standard payment: 50% upfront, 25% at month 4, 25% at month 8. Also asking split invoices across two bill-to entities and final payment Net60. Can Deal Desk / Finance ok?
mira-dealdesk: Need ARR and legal entity names + any underwriting notes. Also any holdbacks?
sam-ae: ARR $480k (40k/mo). Upfront $240k, milestone1 $120k, milestone2 $120k. Bill-to: SolaceMed Holdings LLC (US) and SolaceMed R&D GmbH (DE). Underwriting: soft credit pass, procurement requires split. No holdbacks.
ben-finance: Mixed bill-to OK but we need GL mapping and currency confirmation. Net60 is non-standard; it'll increase DSO but finance can accept if AR manual rule is set. Who pays bank fees?
zoe-legal: Amendment must list both bill-to entities and tax IDs, specify which entity is liable for each invoice, and preserve Master Agreement terms. Add clause: separate bill-to does not relieve primary contracting entity unless stated.
owen-se: Technical note: for Dedicated we'll map cost centers to bill-to; ops ticket required to ensure cost attribution. No blocker.
kate-csm: Customer provided two POs and wants invoice refs to include PO and project code. They've confirmed acceptance criteria for milestones.
mira-dealdesk: Deal Desk can provisionally approve if: (1) GL mapping CSV submitted, (2) POs attached, (3) amendment drafted, (4) underwriting acknowledges split. Also need finance sign-off on Net60.
ben-finance: I approve conditionally after GL mapping. We'll set AR aging override for the SolaceMed R&D Net60 invoices. Bank charges go to customer per standard terms.
zoe-legal: I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment and post here. Key line: "Each Bill-to entity is liable only for invoices issued to it; non-payment by one entity does not excuse payment by another unless expressly stated."
mira-dealdesk: Once amendment, POs, and GL mapping are in, I'll mark Approved-conditional and route to contracts.
sam-ae: Uploaded POs and GL CSV to deal. CFO of SolaceMed confirmed Net60 for DE entity only; US stays Net30.
mira-dealdesk: Split net terms is unusual but acceptable. Finance confirmed manual AR override. Approved-conditional. Route amendment for signatures.
invoice-bot: Invoice ticket INV-2099-221 created and assigned to AR. Reminder set in 72h for signature status.
note: No title field included per agents.md
